questions.question: Where does Jenkins reject form submissions that are missing the anti cross-site request forgery token, and how is that token value generated?
questions.note: The servlet filter checks POST requests for a valid crumb and returns 403; the default issuer hashes user name, session id and a salt.

questions.question: Where is the code that runs when someone starts Jenkins with java -jar on the war file, checks the Java version and boots the embedded web server?
questions.note: Executable war main class with the supported Java version check, option help text and extraction and launch of the bundled Winstone server.

questions.question: Plugins built against an old core version keep working after features were moved out of core into separate plugins. Where does core add those implicit plugin dependencies?
questions.note: Detached plugin list loading and implied dependency computation, called from the classic plugin strategy when reading plugin manifests.

questions.question: Where is an API token sent with HTTP basic authentication checked against the tokens a user has created, and where are those tokens stored in hashed form?
questions.note: Basic header authenticator treats the password as a token and (through a small helper) calls the user property match, which looks it up in the store of SHA-256 hashed tokens.

questions.question: Where is the check that stops an agent from asking the controller to run arbitrary code over the remoting channel?
questions.note: Role checker installed on every channel rejects callables not targeted at the controller role; the base callable and role constants define that role.

questions.question: Where is the logic that picks which agent and executor a waiting build gets assigned to, which makes a job tend to run on the same agent each time?
questions.note: Default load balancer maps work chunks to executor chunks using a consistent hash keyed on the task affinity key over the mapping worksheet.

questions.question: When I type into the search box in the page header, where does the browser code fetch suggestions and which server endpoint answers them?
questions.note: Command palette data source calls the search API helper, which fetches the search suggest URL served by the suggest method on the server search class.

questions.question: How does the H symbol in a periodic build schedule pick a time that is spread out across jobs but stays the same for a given job?
questions.note: Hash seeds a stable pseudo-random generator from the job name, the parser uses it to choose values for H fields, and the help text explains the syntax.

questions.question: In what order does Jenkins start up (plugins, system configuration, jobs), and how can plugin code ask to run at a specific point during startup?
questions.note: Milestone enum lists and orders the startup phases, the annotation lets methods declare after and before milestones, and the runner executes the reactor.

questions.question: How does core automatically find and create the classes that plugins annotate to hook into core features?
questions.note: The finder loads SezPoz annotation indices into a Guice injector, the annotation documents auto registration, and the list holds discovered instances per type.

questions.question: Jobs with thousands of builds do not keep every build in memory. How are old build records loaded on demand and released again under memory pressure?
questions.note: Lazy sorted map retrieves build directories on request, build references hold builds through soft or weak holders, and the run map is the concrete subclass used by jobs.

questions.question: How are passwords and other secrets encrypted when they are saved into XML configuration files, and where does the key that protects them live on disk?
questions.note: Secret encrypts with an AES key and IV, the key comes from a confidential key, and the default store keeps keys under secrets encrypted by master.key.

questions.question: How does core serve WebSocket connections without depending directly on one servlet container's API, and how are idle connections kept alive?
questions.note: Upgrade helper loads a provider through ServiceLoader, the provider interface abstracts the container, and the session schedules periodic pings.

questions.question: How does an inbound agent prove its identity when it connects over WebSocket, and how does the new channel get attached to the right agent node?
questions.note: The WebSocket endpoint compares the agent secret header with an HMAC of the agent name, then the default receiver approves the connection and sets the channel on the computer.

questions.question: What happens when I run the command line client jar in WebSocket mode, from the client opening the connection to the server running the command and returning an exit code?
questions.note: Client parses the mode and connects to cli/ws, the server action checks origin and runs the command in a server side handler, and the plain protocol frames args, stdin, stdout and exit.

questions.question: During first-time setup, when I choose the suggested plugins, what happens between the browser request, the server side install endpoint, the download jobs and the progress polling?
questions.note: JS API posts to installPlugins and polls installStatus; the plugin manager deploys each plugin as update center jobs, which download, verify checksums and report status.

questions.question: What happens after a user clicks Build Now on a job, until an executor actually starts running the build?
questions.note: The build request handler schedules the job in the queue, queue maintenance moves items from waiting to buildable to pending on a free executor, and the executor thread creates and runs the build.

questions.question: How do I build jenkins.war quickly without running tests, and which Maven profiles run only unit tests versus all tests?
questions.note: Contributing guide documents the quick-build command, launching a dev instance and the light-test, smoke-test and all-tests profiles.

questions.question: What sections must a pull request description contain, which changelog category labels can I use, and how many approvals are needed before a maintainer merges it?
questions.note: The template lists required sections and changelog categories, and the maintainer and contributing docs describe the two approval rule and merge process.

questions.question: What does setting a separate resource root URL do, what are the security trade-offs, and how long do those resource links stay valid?
questions.note: Help page explains redirecting user content to a second domain, authentication, HMAC tokens and the 30 minute expiry that the root action enforces.
